description: A dark oil painting of a street brawl. A bearded man in a rough brown jerkin is bent backward while a man in a black coat thrusts a short dagger at his chest. A red banner and a spear lie on the cobblestones. Behind them are canvas tents, a wooden table, hooded onlookers, armoured soldiers, and a crowned rider in armour on a horse with more mounted men and a red pennant. The dress and armour are late medieval or early modern. No text, frame or border; the painting fills the image. A blade is at the chest but no blood or wound is visible.
